market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a former governor of Chungcheongnam Province (2018–2022) and a prominent Democrat. In a competitive province, his likely candidacy should carry at least a 20% baseline probability, far above the market's implied 0.8%. Thin liquidity and distant election date likely cause severe mispricing.
evidence_points: Yang Seung-jo served as Governor of Chungcheongnam Province from 2018 to 2022, giving him high name recognition.
The province swung from Democratic in 2018 to People Power Party in 2022, indicating it is a battleground, not a guaranteed loss.
There is no public scandal or disqualifying event that would drop a major-party returnee below 1% likelihood.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of South Korean provincial elections
